caption: The drawing consists of a symmetrical arrangement of stylized objects centered vertically on a textured beige background. At the top is a large, ornate cross outlined in red, filled with an ochre color and blue decorative accents, with yellow lines radiating outward behind it. Directly below the cross, two upward-curving elements colored ochre, blue, and red form an X-shape, meeting at a small, round central medallion with a blue border and a star motif in the center. On either side of the central medallion, there are two wing-like shapes, each colored ochre and tipped with a red accent. Below the wings and medallion is a large circular object, resembling a medallion or shield, which is bordered in red and blue, filled with an intricate radial pattern consisting of alternating ochre, blue, and red shapes that resemble petals or flames, with a sunburst motif in the center. The drawing uses a limited palette of ochre, red, blue, and yellow, and all objects are outlined in red or blue, contributing to a cohesive composition.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
